snippet.title: Your Own Cozy Motel – Official Trailer v2
snippet.description:
Welcome to Your Own Cozy Motel!
(A game I’m creating entirely on my own in Unity! )

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4668390/Your_Own_Cozy_Motel/

It’s a cozy motel-management experience where you will run, expand, and customize your own motel.

🎮 Planned Release: Steam
👥 Modes: Singleplayer & Co-op (up to 4 players)
🛠️ Engine: Unity

If you enjoy the idea, feel free to leave a comment, subscribe, and follow the journey of building this cozy little motel. Thank you for the support! 💛

https://www.tiktok.com/@littlecrispypickle
